institution: Conservatoire national supérieur de musique et de danse de Lyon (CNSMD Lyon)
qualification: Master (2e cycle supérieur) — diplôme conférant le grade de master (établissement public sous tutelle du Ministère de la Culture)
accreditationStatus: Public, Ministère de la Culture; 2e cycle confers grade de master. REAL master's degree.
durationEcts: 4 semesters full-time / 2 years, 120 ECTS. 'The duration of study is four semesters (full-time), comprising two years of study; this duration may not be shortened.'
whatYouStudy: Electroacoustic music as main discipline; daily studio work; students' creative projects define their individual curriculum. Additional courses available towards Diplôme d'État / Certificat d'Aptitude in music theory or composition.
entryRequirements: 'Non-graduates of the CNSMD Lyon wishing to enter a Master's (2e cycle) programme must hold a Bachelor's, DNSPM, or equivalent degree from a French or international tertiary education institution in the relevant discipline.'
acceptsNonMusic: NO / very unlikely — the degree must be 'in the relevant discipline' (dans la discipline concernée). A BSc Software Engineering would not satisfy this. UNVERIFIED whether any derogation exists.
portfolioSpec: UNVERIFIED — admission is 'based on a submitted dossier' (sur dossier) plus entrance exam; exact number/length/format of works not confirmed from official page (page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch).
auditionSpec: Yes — 'concours d'entrée' / entrance exam qualifying for the Master's degree; admission sur dossier then épreuves. UNVERIFIED exact content.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED — CNSMD Lyon is a Ministry of Culture establishment; droits de scolarité are typically a few hundred euros and frais différenciés (non-EU differentiated fees) do NOT apply to Ministry of Culture establishments. Not confirmed on official page.
otherFees: CVEC (approx. €105/yr) UNVERIFIED; entrance exam registration fee UNVERIFIED
scholarships: UNVERIFIED — Bourse du gouvernement français / Campus France Tunisie and Eiffel (Eiffel normally excludes arts conservatoires; UNVERIFIED)
languageRequirement: French B2 CEFR required for registration to the Master entrance exam for non-French-speaking international students. 'a B1-level certificate may be submitted at registration; however, admission will be contingent upon passing the exam and subsequently providing a B2-level certificate by June 30 of the exam year.' FLE support offered year-round.
deadline: UNVERIFIED — entrance exam registration typically closes in the PRIOR winter/spring (approx. Jan–Mar) for a September intake. For September 2027 entry a Tunisian must ALSO complete the Études en France / Campus France Tunisie procedure (typically opens Oct 2026, closes ~Feb–Mar 2027).

institution: Université Gustave Eiffel, in partnership with INA (Institut national de l'audiovisuel) / INA GRM
program: Master Création musicale et arts sonores
qualification: Diplôme national de master (mention Musicologie / Arts) — REAL master's degree
accreditationStatus: Public university, diplôme national de master. REAL degree. WARNING: INA campus page states the programme 'discontinues from September 2026' — must be re-verified for a September 2027 intake.
durationEcts: 2 years; 137 days of instruction (~240 contact hours per the INA page). 120 ECTS assumed for a DNM. ECTS not stated on page.
whatYouStudy: Five teaching units per semester: cultural foundations and methodology; composition; professional development (English + mandatory internship); INA GRM specialisation (40h/semester: creation techniques, theory, listening, experimentation, dissemination); plus one optional unit from aesthetics/musicology, informatique musicale, or digital arts.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'Titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau bac+3, licence musique ou artistique, diplôme de conservatoire ou d'école d'art de niveau équivalent au niveau L3, autres masters apparentés (180 crédits obtenus après le bac). Pratique musicale ou sonore indispensable.'
acceptsNonMusic: NO as written — requires a music/artistic licence or conservatoire/art-school diploma, and 'Pratique musicale ou sonore indispensable'. A BSc Software Engineering with no portfolio would not qualify.
portfolioSpec: Not mentioned on the page. UNVERIFIED — but 'pratique musicale ou sonore indispensable' implies evidence of practice is expected.
tuitionNonEU: €243/yr stated for formation initiale (standard national master rate). Université Gustave Eiffel is a public university where frais différenciés (€3,879/yr for master) could legally apply to non-EU students — UNVERIFIED whether Gustave Eiffel applies the partial-exemption (most French universities exempt in practice). Continuing-education (formation continue) rate requires contacting the university.
scholarships: UNVERIFIED — no named scheme found on the programme page
languageRequirement: French — level UNVERIFIED (typically B2/C1 for a DNM)
englishTest: Not required (English is taught as a module)
deadline: Applications via monmaster.gouv.fr. National Mon Master window is typically late Feb–late March of the entry year. NOTE: for a Tunisian the Études en France (Campus France Tunisie) procedure runs in parallel from ~Oct of the prior year.

program: Master Arts, mention Musicologie, parcours Création musicale et sonore
qualification: Diplôme national de master — REAL master's degree
accreditationStatus: Public university, diplôme national de master. REAL degree.
durationEcts: 2 years (M1 + M2), 120 ECTS; 660 taught hours (363 in M1, 297 in M2)
whatYouStudy: Composition, improvisation and sound creation; music technology and digital tools; music for film and audiovisual composition; music for theatre and dance; sound installations; multimedia music; studio techniques; supervised projects in M1 and M2 (mandatory); mandatory internship in M2.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'L'accès en M1 est autorisé en cas d'obtention d'une licence (soit 180 ECTS) dans un champ compatible avec celui du diplôme de master ou dans le même domaine.' Compatible degrees listed include music/musicology licences and DNSPM.
acceptsNonMusic: PARTIALLY — the wording is 'un champ compatible', which is broader than 'music only'. The page explicitly names anthropology licences as acceptable for ethnomusicology projects 'with music prerequisites'. A software-engineering BSc is a stretch but the phrasing leaves room; the M1 file would need to demonstrate musical/sonic practice. UNVERIFIED for a non-arts BSc.
portfolioSpec: Not mentioned on the programme page. UNVERIFIED — Paris 8 arts masters normally require a projet de recherche/création plus supporting works.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED — Paris 8 is a public university. Paris 8 has historically exempted non-EU students from frais différenciés (charging the national rate ~€243/yr for master) but this is NOT confirmed for 2027 from an official page.
languageRequirement: French — level UNVERIFIED (normally B2 minimum; often C1 for arts masters)
deadline: UNVERIFIED. Application via monmaster.gouv.fr for M1 for EU/resident candidates; Tunisian candidates resident in Tunisia must use Études en France / Campus France Tunisie (procedure opens ~Oct of prior year).

program: Master Acoustique et musicologie, parcours Ingénierie et conception sonore
qualification: Diplôme national de master — REAL master's degree
accreditationStatus: Public university, diplôme national de master. REAL degree.
durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters, 120 ECTS (60 per year, 30 per semester)
whatYouStudy: S1 common core: 'Penser le son et la musique', 'Explorer et créer'. S2–S3: specialised tracks in physical acoustics, perception/cognition, signal processing, informatics. S4: 5-month mandatory internship (24 ECTS) plus final project defence.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM (mandatory): valid Bac+3 / licence or equivalent; 'Niveau académique solide sur l'ensemble de la formation en licence'; French C1 for non-native speakers from non-French-speaking countries; English B2 minimum; 'Solides connaissances dans les sciences fondamentales (physique, mécanique, informatique, mathématiques)'; strong written and oral French.
acceptsNonMusic: YES — explicitly. 'Recommended backgrounds include physics, mathematics, computer science, engineering'. This is one of the very few programmes in the territory where a BSc Software Engineering is a NATURAL fit rather than a barrier.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED — AMU is a public university; frais différenciés for non-EU master students would be €3,879/yr unless AMU applies the exemption. AMU's exemption policy for 2027 NOT confirmed.
languageRequirement: French C1 explicitly required for non-native speakers from non-francophone countries. NOTE: Tunisia is francophone-adjacent; a Tunisian with fluent French should be able to evidence C1.
deadline: Via monmaster.gouv.fr. Page showed a past cycle window of 1 March – 3 April. For a Tunisian resident abroad: Études en France / Campus France Tunisie procedure instead (opens ~Oct of prior year).
applicationOpens: UNVERIFIED (approx. 1 March in the entry year)

program: Diplôme de l'ENS Louis-Lumière, section Son (Master Son) — options Son pour l'image, Sonorisation, Arts sonores
qualification: Diplôme de l'ENS Louis-Lumière — 'Diplôme de niveau Bac+5 qui confère le grade de Master'. REAL master-grade degree (Arrêté du 28 juillet 2020, JORF, grants grade de master to ENS Louis-Lumière diploma holders).
accreditationStatus: Public grande école (Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur). Grade de master conferred by decree. REAL degree.
durationEcts: 3 years full-time (the three years are inseparable — 'regardless of your level of studies, you must follow the entire programme over all three years'). ECTS UNVERIFIED.
whatYouStudy: Common core in acoustics, signal processing and audio fundamentals; then three specialisations: Son pour l'image (cinema/audiovisual), Arts sonores (electroacoustic, sound installations), Sonorisation (live/concert sound engineering). Theory, practical workshops, collaborative productions.
entryRequirements: Minimum Bac+2 (two years of higher education in the same field: CPGE, university, BTS or equivalent). MAXIMUM AGE 27. Admission by competitive concours only.
acceptsNonMusic: PARTIALLY — requires Bac+2 'in the same field' (i.e. scientific/technical is accepted; the concours is heavily physics/maths-based). A software-engineering BSc satisfies the academic level, but the concours is highly competitive and francophone. NOTE THE AGE LIMIT of 27 — a hard eligibility gate.
portfolioSpec: UNVERIFIED — the concours is written+practical exams, not a portfolio.
auditionSpec: YES — competitive entrance concours held once a year; 16 students admitted per specialisation per year. Written and practical tests. UNVERIFIED exact composition.
tuitionNonEU: Approx. €300/yr tuition + CVEC approx. €104. Public establishment — no frais différenciés reported. Selection/concours fee approx. €80.
totalCostEstimate: Approx. €400–500/yr in fees (excluding living costs). UNVERIFIED for 2027.
scholarships: Bourses sur critères sociaux available to some students (French/EU criteria) — a Tunisian on a student visa is generally NOT eligible. UNVERIFIED.
languageRequirement: French — high level required for the concours. Level UNVERIFIED.
deadline: Concours registration December to January (i.e. Dec 2026 – Jan 2027 for a September 2027 intake). PRIOR CYCLE — this is much earlier than university masters.

institution: ARTS² — Conservatoire royal de Mons (École supérieure des Arts de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles)
program: Master en musique — Composition acousmatique / électroacoustique (section Composition acousmatique)
qualification: Master en musique (grade académique de master, 120 crédits) delivered by an École supérieure des Arts of the Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. REAL master's degree.
accreditationStatus: Recognised École supérieure des Arts, Communauté française de Belgique. REAL master's degree.
durationEcts: Master = 2 years / 120 ECTS (part of a 5-year bachelor+master pathway). UNVERIFIED exact ECTS split.
whatYouStudy: Artistic courses: techniques d'écriture, composition sur support, solfège de l'objet sonore, spatialisation, analyse perceptive. Technical courses: techniques de prise de son, techniques de synthèse, informatique musicale. Taught by more than a dozen active electroacoustic composers. Courses split between Mons and the facilities of Musiques & Recherches (Ohain, ~25 km from Brussels), which provides a specialised sound library and an acousmonium (orchestre de haut-parleurs) for spatialisation classes. Directed by Sophie Delafontaine, Julien Guillamat, Daniel Perez Hajdu, with Roald Baudoux.
entryRequirements: UNVERIFIED for the master entry specifically (bachelor or equivalent + épreuve d'admission). NOTABLE: for the section, 'Access to the training requires no prior knowledge in traditional musical training or instrumental practice (solfège, harmony, instrument practice, etc.)' — stated for the section as a whole. Must be confirmed for master-level (vs bachelor-level) entry.
acceptsNonMusic: LIKELY YES at bachelor level — the section explicitly states no prior traditional musical training is required. For MASTER entry a bachelor in the discipline (or a passerelle/valorisation des acquis) is normally required. UNVERIFIED whether a non-music BSc can enter the master directly; realistically the entry point for this candidate would be the BACHELOR, not the master.
portfolioSpec: UNVERIFIED — an épreuve d'admission applies; exact submission requirements not confirmed from an official page (artsaucarre.be sub-pages returned 404/500).
auditionSpec: Yes — épreuve d'admission (entrance test) applies to all ESA programmes in the Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. UNVERIFIED exact content for this section.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED — Belgian ESA charge a minerval plus, for non-EU students, a 'droit d'inscription spécifique' (DIS). Amount NOT confirmed from an official page. Note Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles institutions apply quotas on non-EU (hors-UE) students in some programmes.
scholarships: ARES Belgium development-cooperation scholarships exist for some countries; UNVERIFIED whether Tunisia is eligible for arts masters.
languageRequirement: French. Non-francophone applicants normally must pass an examen de maîtrise du français. UNVERIFIED.
deadline: UNVERIFIED — Belgian ESA admission tests typically run in late August/early September, with an earlier deadline (usually 30 April) for non-EU 'demande d'équivalence'/visa applicants.

institution: Université de Strasbourg, Faculté des arts
program: Master Musicologie, parcours Création-Production en musiques actuelles
qualification: Diplôme national de master — REAL master's degree
accreditationStatus: Public university, diplôme national de master. REAL degree.
durationEcts: 2 years, 120 ECTS; includes a mandatory 120-hour internship
whatYouStudy: Project-based, combining technical and artistic competencies over four semesters: acoustic musicology and critical listening; recording, mixing and mastering; analogue synthesis and post-production; music composition for audiovisual and video games; sound design fundamentals.
entryRequirements: Requires 'une licence de musique' or an equivalent foreign qualification. Prerequisites: strong proficiency in music production software (DAW); advanced musical practice; composition and/or production competencies; knowledge of sound reinforcement, acoustics or popular-music organology; professional awareness of the musiques actuelles sector; French C1; research competencies and musicological fundamentals.
acceptsNonMusic: NO as written — 'a music licence is mandatory'. Prerequisites also demand advanced musical practice and DAW proficiency. Not viable for this candidate without a prior music qualification.
portfolioSpec: No specific portfolio requirement stated on the page. UNVERIFIED.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED — Université de Strasbourg is public; frais différenciés policy for 2027 not confirmed.
languageRequirement: French C1 ('Strong French writing skills (C1 level mastery)')
deadline: UNVERIFIED — via monmaster.gouv.fr / Études en France for Tunisian residents.
